title: ...move into a new rental apartment
desc: Document pre-existing damage to protect your security deposit upon move-out.
sourceName: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
todos: Walk through entire apartment taking clear photos and videos of existing flaws.
Test all light switches, electrical outlets, window latches, and door locks.
Run water faucets, showerheads, and flush toilets to check water pressure and leaks.
Inspect appliances (stove, oven, fridge) to confirm proper heating and cooling.
Submit official signed condition checklist copy to landlord within 48 hours.
